message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "verify_anatomical_orientation_against_tool_output", "description": "When automated imaging tools report normal anatomical orientation but visual inspection reveals gross structural anomalies (e.g., mirror-image anatomy), prioritize direct pixel-level evidence over tool outputs.", "applicable_conditions": "Tasks involving medical image interpretation where automated classifiers or report generators may fail to recognize congenital anatomical variations or mirror-image structures.", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["medical_imaging_interpretation"], "required_tools": [], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If the chest_xray_classifier or chest_xray_report_generator returns findings consistent with normal anatomy (e.g., levocardia) but visual inspection of the image reveals clear evidence of structural anomalies (e.g., cardiac silhouette on the right, gastric bubble on the right): (1) explicitly reject the tool output as a likely hallucination or limitation regarding mirror-image anatomy; (2) rely on direct pixel-level inspection to determine the correct anatomical orientation; (3) document the discrepancy and base the final interpretation on the visual evidence rather than the automated tool's conclusion."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
